parameters.content:
## Procurement Policy Helpbot
Answers employee procurement and policy questions from an official PDF using Google Gemini, with intent routing, section retrieval, confidence-based escalation, Slack alerts, and Google Sheets audit logging.

### How it works
1. Validates the webhook question payload
2. Downloads and extracts the policy PDF
3. Classifies question intent (approvals, vendors, POs, contracts, general)
4. Retrieves the most relevant policy sections (lightweight RAG)
5. Asks Gemini for a grounded JSON answer with confidence + citations
6. Returns the answer when confidence ≥ threshold; otherwise creates a helpdesk ticket and Slack alert
7. Logs every interaction to Google Sheets for compliance

### Setup steps
1. Edit **Set Workflow Configuration** — set `POLICY_PDF_URL`, `CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD`, `HELPDESK_TICKET_URL`, `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`, `AUDIT_SHEET_ID`, company details
2. Attach **Google Gemini** credentials on **Ask Gemini Policy AI**
3. Attach **Google Sheets OAuth2** credentials on both audit-log nodes and select/create sheet tab `Policy_Interaction_Log`
4. Create helpdesk endpoint (or webhook.site for testing) and optional Slack Incoming Webhook
5. Activate workflow and `POST` JSON to `/procurement-policy-helpbot`

### Example input
```json
{"message":"What approval is required for purchases over $10,000?","userId":"EMP001","channel":"web","sessionId":"S123"}
```

## 1. Intake & Configuration
• `Receive Policy Question`: POST `/procurement-policy-helpbot`
• `Manual Test Trigger`: canvas testing
• `Set Workflow Configuration`: PDF URL, threshold, helpdesk, Slack, sheet ID
• `Normalize & Validate Request`: required message + optional amount
• Invalid payloads return HTTP 400

## 2. Policy Document Ingestion
• Downloads PDF from configured Drive/public URL
• Extracts full text via Extract From File
• Fails gracefully with HTTP 422 if PDF is empty or unreadable
• `Analyse Policy Document` detects domain, structure, forms, and approval limits

## 3. Intent Routing & Section Retrieval
• Classifies into APPROVAL_LIMITS / VENDOR_SELECTION / PURCHASE_ORDER / CONTRACTS / GENERAL_POLICY
• Switch injects intent-specific retrieval hints
• Lightweight RAG ranks policy chunks against the question
• Reduces hallucinations by grounding Gemini on top sections only

## 4. Gemini Answer & Confidence Gate
• Builds strict JSON system prompt (policy-only answers)
• Parses/validates confidence, citations, next actions
• Unusable AI output is forced into escalation path
• Confidence ≥ threshold → answer; else escalate

## 5. Response, Escalation & Audit
• High confidence: format answer + append Sheets log + HTTP 200
• Low confidence: helpdesk ticket → Slack alert → escalation message → Sheets log
• Every path writes compliance audit fields (user, intent, confidence, escalated)

## 6. Global Error Boundary
• `Error Trigger` catches unhandled node failures
• Formats execution ID, failed node, and message
• Posts alert to Slack Incoming Webhook (`SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`)

assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value:
=You are the official procurement policy assistant for {{ $json.company_name }}. Document title: "{{ $json.docTitle }}". Detected domain: {{ $json.domain }}. Question intent: {{ $json.question_intent }} ({{ $json.intent_focus }}).

Answer ONLY using the provided policy excerpts. Do not invent rules, amounts, forms, or contacts.
Document structure: {{ $json.structureType }}. {{ $json.hasApprovalLimits ? 'Extract monetary approval thresholds exactly as written.' : '' }} {{ $json.hasForms ? 'Include form names when relevant.' : '' }} {{ $json.hasPenalties ? 'Mention consequences when relevant.' : '' }}
{{ $json.intent_prompt_addon }}
If the excerpts do not cover the question, say so clearly and set confidence below 0.5.

Respond ONLY with valid JSON (no markdown):
{
  "answer": "Clear explanation grounded in the policy",
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "policySection": "Section/heading where answer was found",
  "nextAction": "Specific next step for the employee",
  "formOrContact": "Form name or contact if present, else null",
  "rulesSummary": "One-sentence key rule",
  "citations": ["Short quote 1", "Short quote 2"],
  "needs_escalation": false
}

Confidence guide: 1.0 explicit wording; 0.7-0.9 clear implication; 0.5-0.69 partial; <0.5 not covered.
